messages.author: da33143a8db60ce8
messages.subject: qu about shinystan
parts:
Hi, when I launch shinystan, I can look at the results, but then I have to close it before I do anything else in R. Is that just the way it is, or is there a way to keep the shiny window open while I R?
thx
A

messages.author: fc5d3270037d7478
messages.subject: Re: qu about shinystan
parts:
On one hand that's just the way it has to be because of how Shiny works. On the other hand it's possible to get around this by opening multiple R sessions and running shinyStan in a separate session from the one in which you want to continue working. That should work fine. 

Jonah
